title: Runtime and logging
summary: Owns time, request, URI, and logging seams that keep business logic deterministic and observable.

public_contracts.name: ClockInterface / RequestContext / UriFactory
public_contracts.summary: Provide deterministic seams for time, request metadata, and URI parsing.

public_contracts.name: LoggerInterface
public_contracts.summary: Provides the minimal structured logging contract Podquilt uses across orchestration and feed processing.

invariants.statement: Runtime seams stay injectable so tests can remain deterministic.
File logger paths resolve relative to the project root unless configured as absolute paths.

performance_constraints: Logging and runtime helpers should stay small and side-effect bounded.
